title: Print one line per ready task
body:
Plain `krn task ready` prints every ready task as a full record with its body (15 tasks ≈ 90 lines), so the lead scans a wall of text to pick the next task. Print one line per ready task (id, priority, title, after) like `krn task list`, keep full records for `show` and `ready --explain`, and leave `--json` unchanged.
Acceptance: executable CLI coverage shows one line per ready task in priority order and an unchanged JSON envelope.
